title: Douxo S3 PYO Pads, 3% Chlorhexidine Wipes (30 ct)
writeup: Douxo S3 PYO Pads are a 30-count jar of Ceva's 3% chlorhexidine cleansing pads for dogs and cats, the same item vets often recommend for skin folds and paws.
